provenance: Butte County GIS public Addresses point layer. County documentation states points are relative positions within the associated parcel, not exact rooftop locations.
districtJoin: Point contained by exactly one dissolved district polygon; boundary or ambiguous points excluded. Excludes points whose county address-layer Supervisor attribute conflicts with the current polygon assignment; the conflicting attribute is not substituted as truth.
knownLimitations: Data reflects the published county address-point snapshot; new or unassigned addresses may not be present. Butte County describes these public address points as relative positions within associated parcels, not exact rooftops.
